header.title: Daybook AI
header.subtitle: AI tax returns for UK accountancy practices.
header.description: AI does the sorting. Your accountants sign it off. HMRC gets the return.

plain.line: Daybook AI reads your clients' bank statements, suggests an HMRC category for every transaction and flags the ones it is unsure of. Your accountants check and sign off, and the return goes to HMRC through Making Tax Digital, under your practice's brand.
who: UK accountancy practices that want to handle more returns
Practices with landlord and sole-trader clients
Firms that want client data kept on their own servers or cloud

intro.title: The AI sorts. People decide.
intro.body: Clients upload bank statements as a PDF, a CSV or a photo. Daybook AI suggests a category for every line, with its reason, and learns from what your team confirmed last year. It never works out the tax or the VAT boxes, and it never files: a rules engine and HMRC do the sums, and a person ticks the declaration.

items.title: Making Tax Digital for Income Tax and VAT
items.text: File Self Assessment and VAT returns through HMRC's Making Tax Digital service. Live filing is switched on once your practice has HMRC production access, and the licence includes help getting it.

items.title: Your brand, not ours
items.text: Clients use a web app in your practice's name and upload statements from their computer or phone.

items.title: Your servers or your cloud
items.text: Run it on your own servers, or in your own AWS, Azure or Google Cloud account in a UK region. Client data stays inside your practice's environment.

items.title: Pilot, CoPilot and AutoPilot
items.text: Three operating modes set how the AI works alongside your team.

items.title: Secure sign-in and a full record
items.text: Two-step sign-in, single sign-on for your staff (Google or SAML), and every change recorded in an audit trail.

items.title: Bank statements as they come
items.text: PDF, CSV or a photo. CSV layouts from Lloyds, Halifax, Bank of Scotland and HSBC are recognised.

aiAngle.title: What the AI does, and what it never does
aiAngle.intro: A person stays in charge of every return.
points: Reads statements and suggests a category for every line, with its reason

deploy.title: How it is priced
deploy.body: An enterprise licence, quoted on how many clients you serve, after a 30-minute scoping call. Every practice starts with a pilot. The licence includes the branded web app, AI set-up, Making Tax Digital for Income Tax and VAT, UK hosting or on-premise set-up, and help getting HMRC production access.
